productionBaselineEvidence: Native DEV Android compiler run 45141648091 succeeded for SHA 5995860ef5e8b600e79c342ca06d59a86f76a412 (20 source tests, 15 Gradle tasks). Main source SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f. Neither production runtime nor Android device has been verified; release remains blocked.
chosenApproach: Use deterministic source ZIP -> isolated unpacked Godot project -> pinned Linux export preset -> native GDPC PCK -> headless main-scene/World smoke -> SHA manifest and app-private assets; one-shot GitHub Actions under 14 minutes, no artifact upload or APK.
